name: 195. xAI native Messages forwards the body byte-for-byte (TXE-5193) (xai-native-byte-exact)
description: Fork contract (TXE-5193): the xAI native Anthropic Messages passthrough (POST /anthropic/v1/messages routed to xAI) forwards the request body byte-for-byte, system included. Upstream's StripAnthropicOnlyFields opt-in removed Claude Code's safeguards, diagnostics and a standalone x-anthropic-billing-header system block before xAI. The native passthrough returns xAI's bytes with no raw_request capture, so these cases observe forwarding through the model: the billing-header block carries a nonce (cch=kv7q2z) that the model can only repeat if the block reached it. Before the fix the block is stripped and the reply is NONE; after it the reply carries the nonce. Both cases also require xAI to accept a body carrying safeguards and diagnostics with HTTP 200. Byte-exactness itself is pinned by TestAnthropicMessagesRouteXAIForwardsBodyByteExact in transports/bifrost-http/integrations. Run with FEATURE=xai-native-byte-exact.
